title: Beyond Wasserstein Proximity: Finding Better Transfer Sources
abstract: arXiv:2610.35314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Source selection often favors similar data, yet marginal proximity need not identify the most useful pretraining source. We motivate a conditional alternative through domain-adaptation theory and a regression example in which broader source variation improves estimation despite increasing Wasserstein distance. We examine five-day cryptocurrency volatility using ten Binance spot assets, six forecaster families, three seeds, and shared temporal cutoffs. Selecting the three farthest rather than nearest Gaussian-Wasserstein sources improves mean persistence-relative skill by 12.52 percentage points for MLP and 20.90 for Transformer, with positive post-hoc paired date-block intervals. Forward pilot selection improves mean skill over random transfer in all six families. translated_title: 超越Wasserstein邻近性：寻找更好的迁移源
translated_abstract: 源选择通常偏爱相似的数据，然而边缘邻近性未必能识别出最有用的预训练源。我们通过领域适应理论和一个回归示例论证了一种条件性的替代方法：在该示例中，更广泛的源变化尽管增大了Wasserstein距离，却改善了估计效果。我们利用十种币安现货资产、六类预测器家族、三个随机种子以及统一的时间切分点，对五天加密货币波动率进行了研究。选择距离最远的而非最近的高斯-Wasserstein源，使MLP的平均持续性相对技能提升12.52个百分点，Transformer提升20.90个百分点，且事后配对日期块区间均为正。前瞻性试点选择在所有六个预测器家族中均优于随机迁移的平均技能。紧凑的循环神经网络模型实现了最低的平均绝对误差，这表明迁移源的选择效用与预测模型本身的质量是相互分离的。回顾性五候选筛选显示了额外的（优势）。
tldr: 该论文证明Wasserstein距离等边缘邻近性指标并不一定能选出最有用的迁移源，提出基于领域适应理论的条件性选择准则，并在加密货币波动率预测实验中表明选择最远而非最近的源能显著提升预测技能，且源选择效用与最终预测模型的质量相互独立。
en_tdlr: Marginal Wasserstein proximity does not necessarily identify the most useful transfer source; using a conditional selection criterion motivated by domain adaptation theory, the paper shows that choosing the farthest rather than nearest sources significantly improves cryptocurrency volatility forecasting skill, and that source selection utility is independent of the final model's forecasting quality.
